notes.title: Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut comes to PC and Mac as 100% FREE DLC
notes.content:
Hi there!

I'm really proud to announce that the latest update for Lone Survivor, (now known as The Director's Cut), is now live on Steam.

For more information about the update, please see my blog at:

[url]http://www.superflatgames.com/wordpress[/url]

The changes took me close to a year to make, but in the end I decided to give it away FREE, as a gesture of thanks to all the fans on PC and Mac who supported the original game.

Thanks for playing, and I hope you enjoy the new version of the game!

- Jasper
